skill_name: Describe the process of readjusting to civilian life after a period of military service.
workflow: Readjusting to civilian life after a period of military service is often a difficult transition. It can involve struggles such as identifying a new purpose after leaving a structured military environment, developing a new network of civilian friends, dealing with post-traumatic stress, and becoming reacquainted with family members.
